description: Chunky lifestyle runner on a sculpted, layered dual-density midsole. Engineered mesh base with synthetic nubuck overlays cut with two windows, a moulded heel wrap, webbing lace loops under a padded gusseted tongue, and a rubber toe bumper. Visible forefoot pod in a contrast colour.
fabricSummary: Engineered mesh · synthetic nubuck overlays · TPU heel wrap · dual-density EVA · rubber
fitBlock: Runner last, D width, true to size

callouts.label: Heel wrap
callouts.spec: Moulded TPU heel wrap 1.5 mm bonded over mesh
callouts.note: Edge radius as photo; no lift after flex test

callouts.label: Padded tongue
callouts.spec: Gusseted tongue, 10 mm foam, mesh face

callouts.label: Lacing
callouts.spec: 6 webbing lace loops 12 mm bar-tacked under synthetic eyestay; flat lace 8 mm

callouts.label: Upper window
callouts.spec: Synthetic nubuck 1.2 mm overlay with cut-out exposing mesh

callouts.label: Toe bumper
callouts.spec: Rubber toe bumper wraps 15 mm up the vamp

callouts.label: Layered midsole
callouts.spec: Dual-density EVA, Asker C 50 upper / 58 lower, sculpted layer lines

care.instructions: Spot clean with mild soap. Do not machine wash. Air dry away from heat.
